#### Position Summary

The Talent Acquisition Coordinator will be responsible for keeping our hiring process running smoothly, from scheduling and candidate communication to sourcing support, recruitment events, and co-op hiring cycles. This role involves working closely with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and interview panels to ensure every step of the hiring journey is well-coordinated and on track.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This is a full-time, permanent position based out of our Vancouver office, working on a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office).

#### What You'll Be Doing

- Coordinate interview scheduling and serve as a key point of contact for candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels, delivering a smooth and timely candidate experience
- Lead the co-op hiring program, running 3 hiring cohorts per year and campus events
- Support recruiters by sourcing and engaging candidates for open roles, including high-volume hiring cycles, using LinkedIn Recruiter and other channels
- Prepare job postings, create jobs in our applicant tracking system (Ashby), and keep candidate records and statuses accurate
- Support offer letter preparation, new hire onboarding logistics, and basic recruiting metrics reporting
- Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.
- Use AI tools through a repeatable workflow to draft candidate communications and sourcing outreach, support scheduling coordination, and summarize interview feedback notes, reviewing every output for accuracy and confidentiality before it is sent or recorded

#### What You'll Bring

- High school diploma or equivalent required; post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is an asset
- 2–5 years of experience in a coordination, administrative, or customer-facing role
- Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and timelines without dropping details
- Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers
- A proactive, detail-oriented approach, with comfort asking questions and flagging opportunities for improvement
- Experience with the following tools/technology: applicant tracking systems, sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, scheduling tools, and standard office/productivity software
- Experience using AI tools as a routine part of your own work through a repeatable process, with a habit of checking the output for accuracy before relying on it

#### Nice to Have

- Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
- Exposure to resume screening
- Experience with an applicant tracking system such as Ashby or Greenhouse

#### Interview Process

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

- Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes
- Hiring Manager Interview: 45–60 minutes
- Panel/Presentation: 60 minutes
- Final Leadership Interview: 30–45 minutes
